fixture_files.description: Typed test-owned composition of the existing resource-cdp-attachment fixture; clearly unbound scoped SQL seed and real Next-action transport adapter, requiring production binding before activation. No fabricated durable result, synthetic provider endpoint or absent dependency import.

fixture_needs: Implement bindBookingEditorHarness using existing resourcePage, per-run tests/e2e/.auth/fixture.json admin credentials, and real current booking-authorized membership; no service-role browser/application credential.

Scoped test execution-only adminQuery/adminExec setup of dedicated same-tenant persons/work role/compatible job/customer/facility/contact and fixed Stockholm intervals. Unique descriptions/IDs per test; cleanup only owned rows/restore captured owned fixture changes. No broad seed/reset.

Supply conflict-free/conflicted/persisted-conflict-states modes with independently known engine-fact expectations; mixed mode includes candidate-related accepted/open logical groups and persisted count mode includes accepted/resolved plus multi-association OPEN deduplication.

Bind observation/holding/failure/committed-response-loss to actual Next server action transport after implementation; register before navigation/action, retain real actor/session, and never invent an API URL.

Transient save failure must happen before writes; assert full existing bookingSnapshot equality. Lost response must happen after real SQL commit; committed promise requires durable outcome, never mock 200 or request sent.

Confirmed save observation requires real successful production save/replay confirmation. Spec reads existing bookingSnapshot directly for full bookings/assignees/conflicts/audit and immutable create_result/update_outcomes.

Bind preview race to two actual production preview responses for different candidates with settlement acknowledgments; newest warning expectation includes rule/person/window/collision and accessible timeline. Never return fabricated detector facts.
Dispose all per-test routes/listeners/holds idempotently. The root owns attached browser/server lifecycle; no browser close/launch or process cleanup in the harness.

confidence.rationale: Ready-for-dev spec Tasks & Acceptance and owner Contract D pin retained behavior; existing resources-person-profile.e2e.spec.ts and resource-cdp-attachment.ts establish project test import/sign-in/owned browser use; existing bookings-atdd.ts exposes real bookingSnapshot and SQL migrations establish durable row shape.
